known_measurement_defects: no independent confirmation source exists in the current data spine
technology taxonomy is not versioned by effective date; recent product codes can manufacture apparent entry
~15% of lane 510(k)s are Special (modifications of the filer's own device), so material != technical
lane-wide volume artifacts at the boundary of the original data; no seasonal adjustment (January ~14% below mean)
zero trailing baseline in most stream-months, making rate-ratio alerts fragile where the lane is sparsest
17,308 lane events have no track_id; Draeger and Mindray still absent from config/companies_device.json
bulk lane availability = decision_date + 14 days (estimated), date-level not first-publication
blockers: hiring lag question: unrun - 3 usable companies; the remaining firms are unreachable from this source (D-031), so the limit is now structural
independent change confirmation: trial lane exists but is too sparse at cell level (cycle 5)
patents: no key and no accessible bulk route (B-031)
B-015 matured-forecast calibration blocked on wall-clock (windows close 2027-10)

B-039: fix the OBSERVE deployment resolution and re-run the width sweep there
do not resume hiring probing; the remaining firms are structurally unreachable (D-031)

invariants: data/research.sqlite, data/tkg.sqlite, data/registry.sqlite and all experiments/ artifacts are frozen inputs; never mutate in place
no merge to main without independent verification of the exact commit
every reported number must be reproducible from a committed artifact or command
empty/insufficient data is reported as such, never padded
a null result must be reported with its minimum detectable effect
a detection is a statistical statement about activity rate, never a claim about intent, capability or internal R&D
LLMs may organise evidence and propose hypotheses, never generate facts, citations or probabilities

comovement.question: do several competitors become active in the same technology track at once?
comovement.conclusion: month-level cross-firm synchronisation is not detectable once the track's own growth is conditioned out; the three apparent cases are track growth admitting firms over time
comovement.limitation: most tracks sit below the null because the null draws firm-months independently while firms file in bursts; the test is conservative in the positive direction and the negative direction is an artefact, not anti-synchronisation
